changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.16[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: daily and talk shows found by air date[/COLOR]
-Daily and talk shows are often released with the date in the name instead of a season and episode number (Show.Name.2026.10.20.1080p). luc_kodi now finds those too.
-TVmaze tells which shows are daily, talk, news, variety or game shows. Only those are also searched by air date in The Pirate Bay, Knaben, Newznab and Easynews, so a weekly series costs no extra request.
-A release named with the episode's air date is accepted by every scraper, including Torrentio, Comet, Zilean and the other ones that look up by IMDb. It is checked against the air date of that episode, never the day before or after.
-Inside a season pack, the file named with the air date is the one that plays.
-You can turn the search by air date off in Settings > Accounts (Meta) > TVmaze.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: TVmaze account[/COLOR]
-TVmaze joins Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay and WeTrakr in Settings > Tracking Accounts. The username and API key fields are empty: each user signs in with their own account.
-Sign in with your TVmaze email: TVmaze sends you a confirmation link, and the same link is in the QR of the sign-in window. You can also type the username and API key from your TVmaze dashboard.
-Mark episodes as watched on TVmaze: when 85% of an episode has been played, it is marked as watched on TVmaze. This also works with free TVmaze accounts.
-The right episode is marked even when TMDb and TVmaze number a show differently: the TVmaze episode is checked against the air date, and by name when several aired the same day.
-TVmaze Manager in the context menu of shows and episodes: mark an episode as watched, and follow or unfollow the show.
-TV Shows > TVmaze Followed Shows. Following shows is a TVmaze Premium feature, so free accounts do not get this entry.
-Account info shows your TVmaze plan. The account can be sent to another device with Sync your devices.
-TVmaze shows with its logo in the sign-in window, in the context menu panel and in the Personal Assistant's welcome summary, which now has room for eleven accounts. System status also checks the TVmaze API.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: menus in the new luc_kodi style[/COLOR]
-Trakt, MDBList, SIMKL, WeTrakr, PunchPlay and TVmaze Manager, Playlist Manager and Rescrape Options now open in a window in the same style as the Personal Assistant's welcome, instead of Kodi's plain list.
-At the top, the title you opened the menu from: its poster, the menu name, the episode and show line, and the title in large type.
-Every option takes the whole width of the window, so long ones such as Rescrape Item with Custom Query and All Providers are read in full, with an icon for what it does in the colour of its service.
-The ratings and lists these menus ask for next (Rate, Add to a list, Hide from) open in the same window.
-With the Classic context menu style (Settings > Navigation), Kodi's own dialog opens as before.
[COLOR fffdb515]Better episode matching[/COLOR]
-Single episodes named 1x05, S01 E05, S01.E05, S1E5 or Season 1 Episode 5 are no longer dropped, nor the second episode of a double episode such as S01E04E05.
-Looking for S01E10 no longer accepts S01E100, and S01E05 no longer accepts S01E050. Long-running shows with three- or four-digit episode numbers get the episode you picked.
-Inside a pack, Show.Ep.5 and Show.E5 are found for episode 5.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Season 5 episode 1 and season 7 episode 1 matched every file of a pack with 5.1 or 7.1 audio in the names (DD5.1, AAC.5.1, DDP7.1), so the wrong episode could play. Audio channels no longer count as season and episode numbers.
-A file named with a date (Show.2024.01.05) was taken for episode S01E05 inside a pack.
-A single dated episode of a daily show could be listed as a complete-series pack.
-With service logos turned on, the Originals and Calendars menu rows asked for a TVmaze icon that was missing and showed Kodi's default icon. It is now included.
-When checking a season or show pack failed, the check returned a value the scrapers could not read and a second error was written to the log. It now just skips that release.
